GOV-F-004-S47.title: Audit Log Schema and Storage Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S47.description: Define the canonical append-only audit log schema including event type, actor (GPT/Claude), timestamp, payload hash, previous hash pointer, and metadata. Establish MongoDB collection structure and write-once constraints.

GOV-F-004-S48.title: Append-Only Audit Logging Core Service
GOV-F-004-S48.description: Implement core audit logging service responsible for writing immutable records, enforcing append-only semantics, generating hash chains, and rejecting updates/deletes.

GOV-F-004-S49.title: Audit Log Read API for QA and SIT
GOV-F-004-S49.description: Expose secure read-only API endpoints to retrieve audit logs for QA, SIT, and governance review, including filtering by actor, time range, and event type.

GOV-F-004-S50.title: Audit Logging Unit and Integration Test Suite
GOV-F-004-S50.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating append-only enforcement, hash chain integrity, concurrent write handling, and full coverage of GPT/Claude audit events.
